Chapter 1117 – Liu Qinxin’s Whereabouts

“The person you are searching for might be right next to Sacred King Samsara. Apparently, the Eyes of Samsara can obtain Origin Power of Samsara from the Samsara of Heaven and Earth by killing people that have been reborn through samsara. The person you are searching for might be the person that Sacred King Samsara is searching for as well!”

Xin Wuheng disappeared from the continent zone, but what he said reverberated throughout Zhao Feng’s mind.

“Sacred King Samsara!” Zhao Feng’s body radiated a very powerful killing intent.

Before Xin Wuheng had undergone the God Tribulation, Zhao Feng noticed a soul mark with the power of Samsara on his body. If Zhao Feng was correct, this should be the legendary Mark of Samsara.

The ability of the Mark of Samsara was to recover the souls of the dead and pull them into the Samsara of Death through the Eyes of Samsara. In other words, Sacred King Samsara wanted Zhao Feng to die from the very start, then turn him into a Samsara Immortal Body. Most likely, the reason Sacred King Samsara didn’t just kill Zhao Feng when they first met was because Sacred King Samsara wanted Zhao Feng to become stronger. That way, he would be able to obtain an even stronger Samsara Immortal Body when the time came.

“This means that the friendship from before was all fake!”

Zhao Feng had a cold expression as he remembered what the Six Warlock Divine Sage said; “If you want to confirm the whereabouts of Liu Qinxin, you have to find the Eyes of Samsara.”

What the Sage said meant that Zhao Feng would be able to know the location of Liu Qinxin once he found the Eyes of Samsara, not by asking him.

“Why did I understand that only now?” Zhao Feng said with regret and hatred.

“Qinxin… Qinyin!” Zhao Feng’s eyes were tough.

Sacred King Samsara had the Eyes of Samsara and obviously cultivated the Dao of Samsara, but when Zhao Feng met Liu Qinyin, he didn’t feel any power from the Dao of Samsara in her. This meant that Sacred King Samsara didn’t think of her as a true disciple. Adding on what Xin Wuheng said, Zhao Feng was sure that Liu Qinyin was Liu Qinxin.

The two peerless figures in white in his memories started to combine. Zhao Feng didn’t think that he would have already met Liu Qinxin but missed the chance!

Now that he thought about it, Sacred King Samsara definitely knew that Liu Qinyin was the person that Zhao Feng wanted to find, but he hid it. This also made sense given what Xin Wuheng said – Sacred King Samsara wanted to use Liu Qinyin to increase his own strength.

“Sacred King Samsara only just left the God Corpse. He shouldn’t kill Liu Qinyin so quickly!” Zhao Feng’s expression suddenly changed. He had met Sacred King Samsara twice, so he could feel that Sacred King Samsara’s strength hadn’t increased by much. This meant that Liu Qinyin was still alive.

Zhao Feng glanced toward the sea of lightning before waving his left arm in anger and disappearing in a flash of silver. After understanding everything, Zhao Feng couldn’t just stay here and use the God Tribulation Lightning.

The next instant, Zhao Feng appeared on the battlefield.

At this point in time, most of the people were gathered around the barren grounds of the God Tribulation. The Demigods and Sacred Kings were already starting to head toward the depths.

“Zhao Feng disappeared the instant he came out. He still hasn’t given what he promised me!” Kun Yun swore in anger and activated his Golden Kun Sacred Body. His resistance against God Tribulation Lightning was very strong, so he was able to enter further than all the other Demigods present.

“Brother Feng, where are you going?” Zhao Yufei suddenly felt uneasy.

Weng~ Weng~

A faint ripple of golden light swept over the area, but Zhao Feng didn’t find any sign of Sacred King Samsara.

“Bi Qingyue, gather all the intel agents and find the whereabouts of Sacred King Samsara. Search all the places that Sacred King Samsara went before he entered the God corpse….” Zhao Feng communicated with Bi Qingyue directly through the Dark Heart Seal.

In the past, Zhao Feng could only rely on luck to find Sacred King Samsara since he always hid himself and was very low-key, but now since Sacred King Samsara had appeared in the God corpse, there must have been traces, and Zhao Feng could use these tracks to find his location.

“Understood!” Bi Qingyue, who was also gathered around the barren ground of the God Tribulation, immediately retreated with all her subordinates. She could tell how important this issue was from Zhao Feng’s tone.

Shua!

Zhao Feng used the Misty Spatial World and left the battlefield.

At a certain moment, Bi Qingyue sent some information to Zhao Feng through the Dark Heart Seal. Zhao Feng’s expression changed slightly before returning to normal, and he continued on his way.

A day later, Zhao Feng arrived at a simple wooden room that was located within the depths of a forest full of green trees. In front of the wooden room was a gentle stream. A white-clothed young girl had once been here playing the qin.

This was the place that Zhao Feng met Liu Qinyin!

“Qinyin, where are you? I want to hear another song!” Zhao Feng murmured gently as his emotions started to boil. Zhao Feng’s thoughts started to soak into this place, and the power of illusions appeared around him.

At this moment, Zhao Feng recreated the scenery of him meeting Liu Qinyin with just his memories. A girl in white slowly appeared from the stream ahead of him. She held an ancient qin, and an elegant music started to sound.

Boom!

Zhao Feng suddenly destroyed the illusion.

“I must find Qinyin. She’s still in danger and might die any moment!” Zhao Feng’s expression shook as he forced out his emotions.

“Sacred King Samsara!” Zhao Feng said through gritted teeth.

“That’s right! The Mark of Samsara!”

Zhao Feng’s eyes flashed. The Mark of Samsara that Sacred King Samsara had left behind was still in his body. The reason why Zhao Feng hadn’t wiped out this Mark of Samsara immediately was because he was scared of Sacred King Samsara finding out and going on guard against him.

Sacred King Samsara could sense Zhao Feng’s rough location with this Mark of Samsara, but Zhao Feng could also use the Mark of Samsara to find Sacred King Samsara’s location. If used this method, that would reveal that Zhao Feng knew about the Mark of Samsara since Sacred King Samsara would notice Zhao Feng approaching. However, at this point, Zhao Feng didn’t care about that anymore!

Shua!

Zhao Feng’s consciousness entered the depths of his soul and was soon able to find the Mark of Samsara by relying on the powerful ability of his left eye.

Hu~

Zhao Feng released his soul power to awaken the Mark of Samsara.

Weng~~~

A resistive force came from the other side of the Mark of Samsara. At this instant, Zhao Feng’s consciousness sensed a faint soul disturbance at a certain location that resonated with the Mark of Samsara within Zhao Feng’s Lightning Soul Body.

“Found you!” A deadly look flashed through Zhao Feng’s eyes as he started to take action.

Sacred King Samsara had definitely sensed something the moment Zhao Feng used the Mark of Samsara to find him, so Zhao Feng needed to move as quickly as possible so that Sacred King Samsara couldn’t escape.

Whoosh!

Zhao Feng waved his arm guard and disappeared amongst a layer of silver light. Zhao Feng moved across an entire province after using the Misty Spatial World twice.

“It’s in this province!”

Zhao Feng could sense Sacred King Samsara’s rough location through the Mark of Samsara.

Weng~~~

Zhao Feng used the Lightning Wings Flying Technique and sped across Heaven and Earth.

“Sacred King Samsara has already sensed my actions and might have already left his original position!” Zhao Feng had a grim expression.

“Let’s try again!”

Zhao Feng’s consciousness entered the depths of the soul and decided to touch the Mark of Samsara once more.

“It’s…”

Zhao Feng’s expression froze as he stood still. A gray figure slowly appeared before Zhao Feng a while later.

“Sacred King Samsara!” Zhao Feng’s expression was cold as killing intent radiated from him.

“Zhao Feng, why are you in such a rush to find me?” Sacred King Samsara looked at Zhao Feng and revealed a faint smile.

“Did you know that the person I was searching for was Liu Qinyin from the beginning!?” Zhao Feng asked in a low tone.

“That’s right, but she’s my target, so I can’t let you take her away!” Sacred King Samsara revealed a decisive look.

Sacred King Samsara had used the ability of his right eye to find four “samsara reborn.”

The death of the first samsara reborn allowed him to break through to the Mystic Light Realm. The death of the second allowed him to become a Sacred King. Sacred King Samsara didn’t find any opportunities that could allow him to break through to the Heavenly Divine Realm in the God corpse, so he could only use the third samsara reborn – Liu Qinxin – to assist his break through to the Heavenly Divine Realm.

Liu Qinxin’s soul contained powerful laws of Samsara, and she was very talented in the Dao of Life as well. If it wasn’t for the fact that the Heavenly Divine Realm was such a big gap, Sacred King Samsara wouldn’t want to kill his third disciple.

The fourth samsara reborn that Sacred King Samsara had found was Xin Wuheng, but Sacred King Samsara always felt as if there was a profound power stopping him from approaching Xin Wuheng.

“Well,

you

are

my

target, so you must die!” Zhao Feng had a grim expression. He definitely wouldn’t let Sacred King Samsara off after he admitted everything.

“You can’t kill me with your strength!” Sacred King Samsara said confidently. However, even though he said this, Sacred King Samsara was still somewhat wary of Zhao Feng after the battle in the God corpse. In didn’t matter though, because Liu Qinyin was about to die, and his strength would increase dramatically. It was impossible for Zhao Feng to be his match.

“How would I know without trying?” Zhao Feng snickered coldly.

“Do you not want to know the whereabouts of Liu Qinyin?” Sacred King Samsara laughed smugly.

Liu Qinyin was very talented in the Dao of Life and could detect danger, but Liu Qinyin was talented

only

in this aspect. Sacred King Samsara had never let Liu Qinyin cultivate any other techniques from the Dao of Life or let her read any knowledge about the Dao of Life, so Liu Qinyin’s usage of the Dao of Life was very normal.

Sacred King Samsara had left a Samsara Immortal Body near Liu Qinyin before he entered the God Corpse. Of course, Sacred King Samsara didn’t tell the Samsara Immortal Body what the mission was earlier, but at this moment, Sacred King Samsara had given the order to the Samsara Immortal Body to kill Liu Qinyin.

…

There was a pretty stream near the edge of the province that Zhao Feng was in. Next to the stream was a cave. The setup within the cave was the same as a normal family.

At this moment, a snow-white figure walked out from the cave.

“What should I do? The sense of danger is becoming stronger and stronger, but Master told me to wait here for him….” Liu Qinyin’s expression was becoming impatient.
